# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2), as of Oct 2026

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- Three of the roundups pick it as best overall. It includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, rotates between portrait and landscape, and takes cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Vent fit matters. Belkin says slats should be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and horizontal slats work best. Vertical or shallow vents may droop.
- Belkin also makes a vent/dash version, listed at the same price, for cars with awkward vents.
- Where to buy: the "Buy on Amazon" links in [RottenWiFi's guide](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/) and [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/).

**Fastest and most reliable: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933), $89.99 list**
- It's Qi2 25W with thermoelectric cooling and a fan, which helps when you run navigation in the sun. The MountGuys reviewers use it daily, and [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) saw it at $69.99 on sale.
- Sources disagree on power. MountGuys and The Gadgeteer say a 60W adapter is in the box. RottenWiFi says you need a 45W+ USB-C car adapter. Check the listing before buying.
- Real 25W speeds only apply to the iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get up to 22W, and the iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W.
- It doesn't fit Teslas, Mercedes-Benz vehicles, or cars with nonstandard vents. The iPhone 16e isn't compatible.
- Where to buy: [MountGuys review](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) (Amazon link inside).

**Best value with a cooling fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
- It's Qi2-certified at 15W, with a fan that aims to prevent heat throttling. It mounts on a vent or the dash.
- Prices vary by source: $39.99 at ESR's store, $35.99 or $18.99 on Amazon per The Gadgeteer, whose figures conflict with each other. A car adapter may not be included, so budget about $10–15 more.
- Dealectric, an affiliate coupon site, reports that code PARTNER18 took $7.19 off at ESR's store on Oct 22, bringing it to $32.80. The code expires 12/31/2026 and checkout has the final word: [ESR HaloLock CryoBoost](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost).

**Best 25W with an adapter included: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, about $39.95**
- The Gadgeteer ranks it best overall for iPhone 16/17. It ships with a 95W adapter, but the fan must stay on to get 25W. Find it through [The Gadgeteer's roundup](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/).

**Quick pick**
- Simple and complete: Belkin.
- iPhone 16 or 17 and a hot climate: Anker Prime, or LISEN to save money.
- Tight budget: ESR CryoBoost.

I can't check live prices, so confirm them at checkout. Tell me your phone model and vent type and I can narrow this down.
